div.div:
The tasks with the highest priority are taken first; if there are no high priority tasks in queue and none are executing, lower priority tasks are taken to be processed
The latter condition guarantees that any aggregation tasks, which have lower priority than batch processing tasks, will only start executing when all of the processing tasks are finished
